enforced_by: the copywriter and the video teardown read it; nothing refuses an unknown value
note: One list per dial — humour, delivery style, register, pacing, reference world, avoid; the asset is the dial.

rows.name: deadpan
rows.what: Everything said level, with nothing in the face or the voice selling it.

extra.when: Rooms that punish enthusiasm; any beat where the claim has to sound like a fact rather than a pitch.

rows.name: confessional
rows.what: Said as an admission, to one person, as if it had not been planned.

extra.when: The beat where the viewer has to see themselves in the speaker before anything is claimed.

rows.name: teacher-explainer
rows.what: One idea at a time, shown while it is said, with the viewer allowed to keep up.

extra.when: A market sophisticated enough to demand a mechanism rather than a claim.

rows.name: rant
rows.what: Said at speed and at pressure, with the annoyance plainly real.

extra.when: The beat where the alternatives get taken apart.

rows.name: storyteller
rows.what: A thing that happened, told in order, with the turn kept until it earns its place.

extra.when: A claim the room will not accept stated, but will accept arrived at.

rows.name: hype
rows.what: Everything said at volume and at speed, with the energy carrying the claim.

extra.when: A room that runs hot itself, and only where the claim is already believed.

rows.name: plain-testimonial
rows.what: A person saying what happened to them, in their own words, with nothing tightened.

extra.when: The proof beat, and any room whose scepticism is aimed at production value itself.

rows.name: deadly-sincere
rows.what: A real limitation admitted openly and without softening, so the claim that follows lands harder.

extra.when: A market that has heard every claim in the category and believes none of them.

rows.name: understatement
rows.what: Plain, short, adjective-light — the claim stated smaller than it is and then left alone.

extra.when: Any room where the size of a claim is itself the reason it is disbelieved.

rows.name: interview-consult
rows.what: A question the room actually asks, asked out loud, and answered at length.

extra.when: Where the mechanism needs an authority and the authority needs someone to speak to.

rows.name: reaction-duet
rows.what: The reaction is on screen beside the thing being reacted to — a second frame, a second voice.

extra.when: Where the room's own native format is commentary rather than address.

rows.name: hands-and-voiceover
rows.what: No face. Hands doing the thing, a voice over the top of it.

extra.when: Where the thing itself is more persuasive than anyone describing it, and where no cast face is cleared.

rows.name: Holistic healer authority
rows.what: The claim is carried by an elder practitioner speaking from years of practice, not from a study — the kitchen, not the lab. Calm, unhurried, names ingredients she recognises (turmeric, ginger, chamomile), and the reader answers her rather than being sold to.
rows.why_it_works: Her trust bar is 'can I find this in my kitchen?' and 'would my holistic doctor approve?' — the voice that already has her trust is the one that can make the claim.
rows.examples: A brand's story file naming the teller 'the kitchen, not the lab — the elder practitioner, with the reader answering'; a swiped ad written as a grandma's holistic blog
rows.evidence: the owner 2026-09-19: 'the holistic healer authority'. Moved from format/video 2026-09-28: it is how the ad sounds (a delivery style), not a format. Backed by customer lines in one brand's language bank asking for what 'a holistic doctor would approve'.
